test_title: PYST 153: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 06 Feb, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Six persons H, R, J, S, N and B are sitting in a row facing North. B is not sitting beside J, who is sitting at the extreme right. H is the immediate neighbour of N and B. N is not sitting beside S and J. R is the immediate neighbour of S and J. Who is sitting to the immediate right of B?
solution:
Six persons **H, R, J, S, N and B** are sitting in a row facing North.

1. B is not sitting beside J, who is sitting at the extreme right.

2. R is the immediate neighbour of S and J.

3. N is not sitting beside S and J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c0914ae891f4261fc09dabbcb539a2850cec84b6afc06a66bccf8ef44c6a870c.png] 

4. H is the immediate neighbour of N and B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/263c0e9028c3b2126f84fe664f719c83a56165c5608b3cd2cf3bcb042ba4f8eb.png] 

Clearly, S is sitting to the immediate right of B.

Hence, ‘**S**’ is the correct answer.
